parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch lever of a wall switch, made of durable ABS plastic. It is the movable part that users press to toggle the electrical circuit.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the actuator that opens or closes the electrical circuit when pressed up or down.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rocks slightly around a central axis to change between ON and OFF positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting plate of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate plastic. It provides structural support and houses the internal electrical components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanism in place and attaches to the wall or electrical box, ensuring stability and insulation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
